title: Barbiana Liu — a cut-out figure among ASCII drawings, labels as nav
note: One screen, no scroll. "BARBIANA LIU" in a condensed grotesk, 176px uppercase, -1.8px tracking, spans the top. In the middle a cut-out photo of her stands on white; around it two large drawings (a cherub, a cross on a chain) are made only of characters: $, +, |, / in tiny mono. The nav is four black boxes with white bracketed caps, [WORK] [CONTENT] [DESIGN BODEGA] [CONTACT ME], dropped on top of the drawings at slight offsets. Bottom corners hold the email and a live clock ("Mon 03:18:46 AM"). Body copy is a 17px sans at 600 with -0.8px tracking. Built in Readymag. Worth reusing: ASCII art as illustration that matches the type, and labels placed like stickers rather than in a bar.
